name: mg-road
source: Overture Maps Foundation (ODbL) -- OSM + Google + Microsoft, GERS-deduplicated
heightsNote: Heights, best evidence first: cited published figures (5), OSM height tags (36), OSM building:levels x 3.33 m fitted from 34 local buildings of at least 5 storeys carrying both tags (528), else zonal p65 of Open Buildings 2.5D at ~4 m. A p65 under 2.0 m is refused as not credible and falls back to the 2.5 m fill. Google's value is kept on every building as hGoogle.
